title: Form-to-Sheet Automation
summary: Google Form responses land in a formatted sheet without breaking formulas, plus an automatic summary report.
result: Zero manual copy-paste: every response lands in the right row and a PDF summary goes out every Monday.

metric.label: manual steps between a form response and the weekly report

note: Demo built with fictitious order-request data.

screenshots.alt: Orders sheet: a new form response written into the formatted table, formulas and dropdowns intact
Weekly PDF summary generated and emailed every Monday by Apps Script

upworkBlurb: Google Apps Script automation that writes Google Form responses into a formatted Google Sheet without breaking existing formulas, validation or formatting (the default form link overwrites them). Each response is cleaned, written to the right table row, and a weekly summary is generated as a PDF and emailed automatically on a time trigger. No add-ons, no paid tools. Demo uses fictitious data. Stack: Apps Script, Google Sheets, Forms, Gmail.
